answer: Each identity may register only one vault, identified by a locked radio-spectrum lease that cannot be restaked. A payout clears only when the agent deposits a pearl: the hash of a one-shot frequency-hop I/Q capture plus its hop nonce, unused in any other vault. A colliding capture is refused and the later lease is frozen unsaleable. A network beacon then pings random lease-holders at an unpredictable minute and demands a fresh hop from the same lease; aliases sharing one transmitter cannot answer two pings at once, so extra heads miss the ping and forfeit that epoch's claim.
